recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-3073 source edit is needed; changing the current section merely to match the original Jira wording would be redundant and could conflict with later accepted FHIR-16470/FHIR-16466 wording.

additional_context: Later Published issues FHIR-16470 and FHIR-16466 reworked the same Managing Resource Identity section. FHIR-16470 removed the term "re-identification" in favor of assigning new ids, and FHIR-16466 made managing.html informative while moving broader identity terminology to resource.html#id. Related FHIR-16470, FHIR-16466, and FHIR-17707 already have reconciliation commits on the combined branch.
